segments.summary: Reviewed locked shell/browser/debug decisions, SSH credential custody, and Dashboard widget-grid scope, behavior, continuity, default composition, and accessibility negative space.
Reviewed add-widget flow, exact catalog oracle, atomic/page-widget ownership, layout migration and precedence, plus provider support-state freshness and offline behavior.
Reviewed Persona instruction semantics, editor fields and labels, compatibility copy, owner-field identity, active-run truth, and full display-consumer propagation.
Reviewed trace summaries, Persona invocation and provider-gap disclosure, mapping editors, and shared rendering scope with privacy, lifecycle, and trust-boundary adversarial checks.
Reviewed capture-chip transitions, browser-debug ownership and safety, URL binding, host placement, session classes, and Markdown/Mermaid rendering under race, privacy, and untrusted-input lenses.
Reviewed Chat HTML prohibition, Context Lens modes, File Editor rendering and buffer authority, local HTML routing, Embedded Document Pane reuse, and bottom-panel role limits.
Reviewed browser action identity, CEF runtime baseline and recovery, rendering performance and accessibility, and Assistant Chat planning/PT controls with operational failure and oracle checks.

Reviewed Plan/Deep Plan artifacts, TODO authority and state, annotation recovery, document rendering, wizard recommendation, and imported-context handoff under concurrency, trust, and partial-failure lenses.
